summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Material Fact regarding its out-of-court reorganization (Extrajudicial Reorganization) filed by the Company and certain subsidiaries. The filing notes that Braskem provided non-public information to senior note and debenture holders under confidentiality agreements entered in August 2026, with the information now publicly available. No specific financial terms, stake percentages, or prices were disclosed. The reorganization appears to be a debt restructuring under Brazilian law, analogous to a Chapter 11 proceeding. Key watch items include negotiation progress with creditors and the reorganization plan's terms.
